newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin ad agency Dorland sees 20 pct growth in '97.
newsitem.headline: Berlin ad agency Dorland sees 20 pct growth in '97.

text.p: Berlin-based advertising agency Dorland said on Friday it expected a 20 percent boost in turnover for 1997, propelled by publicity generated by its recent capture of Honda's German image account.
"The Honda account has provided us with a lot of interesting inquiries from other companies," Dorland managing director Stefan Hansen told Reuters.
The agency won the 40-million-mark account for the Japanese auto maker in May.

Dorland has 65 employees in Berlin and currently represents an account volume of 176 million marks, Hansen said, adding that total advertising volume reaches 200 million marks when its business in eastern Europe is included.
The Duesseldorf-based Grey group owns a 50 percent share in the Berlin Dorland agency.
